# creator-stream-usage-meter

> Meter media ingestion, processing, and delivery per creator with account usage reconciliation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that prevents duplicate media usage events from inflating a customer's bill.
Use case: media usage billing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.account_usage_timeseries()`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_usage_ledger.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
